question: Will the Patriots reach Ukraine in time, yes or no?

lines.text: The US has cleared a two point one billion dollar sale of five hundred Patriot missiles to Ukraine.
But President Zelensky says the deal states deliveries may begin only in a few years.

scene.quote: deliveries may begin ONLY IN A FEW YEARS

lines.text: They are PAC three MSE interceptors, among the few that can stop Russian ballistic missiles.
The State Department says the sale will improve Ukraine's capability to meet current and future threats.
lines.note: US State Dept, via Kyiv Post

scene.quote: improve Ukraine's capability to meet current and future threats

lines.text: It says no US money will be used for the purchase.
Canada, Germany and Norway are paying, with an EU funded loan to Ukraine.
Congress can still review it, and no delivery date was given.
Zelensky asked for one hundred PAC three missiles a month this winter.
He wants the US and European allies to send missiles from their own stocks now, and refill them from the new order.
He says Russia made more than thirty attacks on Ukraine's power grid in the last two weeks of October.
Lockheed Martin, the main contractor, plans to lift output from about six hundred a year to two thousand by twenty thirty.
Will the Patriots reach Ukraine in time, yes or no?
